name: codex-telegram
description: Privacy-first local Telegram user-account access through TDLib and MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use your personal Telegram account privately from Codex.
interface.longDescription: A local TDLib-based MCP server for reading Telegram, sending explicitly approved messages, downloading files, and using safe bot callback buttons. Credentials and sessions remain on the user's device.
defaultPrompt: Find messages about the website deadline.
Open a bot menu and list its safe callback buttons.
